**Short answer**  
The punishment for murder in India is death or life imprisonment (with a possible fine) under the Indian Penal Code, 1860 §302 [1]. Under the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, 2023 the same punishment applies – death or imprisonment for life (the latter meaning the remainder of the natural life) and a fine [4].

- The Indian Penal Code (IPC), which remains in force for offences committed before the 1 July 2024 transition, provides in Section 302 that “whoever commits murder shall be punished with death or imprisonment for life, and shall also be liable to fine” [1].
